Name: Sunnyfield Shops
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[center][font=Arial]Sunnyfield brings in a new simple location for the valley farmers out there. Enjoy and explore new shops, new characters, and discover what lies behind them.

Hi all! It's been a while since making any updates. I'm so soo sorry for all the translation files given to me, the requests, and the other to-dos that I had to move. I've been spending my time learning how to make custom stuffs (maps, npcs, etc). I've also been trying to learn to do pixel art (it's hard for me atleast). While it had occupied most of my available time, it's really fun learning new stuffs in modding!


For [url=https://github.com/LyzzCL/BusLocations/releases/tag/1.3.1]Bus Locations requirement[/url]﻿, please download the [b]BusLocations-1.3.1-lyzzcl-fix.zip [/b]not the source code zip.
This one has controller support (aside from keyboard-mouse) but if you use keyboard-mouse only, you may use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21264]this[/url].

For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿, please go ahead and create a folder (you can name it as 'Sunnyfield Portraits') in Portraiture/Portraits folder. So it should be something like Portraiture/Portraits/Sunnyfield Portraits. Then copy & paste the content of Portraits folder from the Sunnyfield mod.  
﻿
If you don't want to wait for Pam, you can use this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29837]Bus without Pam[/url]﻿.

If you enjoy my works, consider supporting me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/novaphene]ko-fi[/url]﻿. It is much appreciated but this is never required.

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/EcrvsQR.png[/img]
My main idea for making Sunnyfield is to make diverse shops for accessibility and convenience (except where you'd need for Pam for the bus).
[/font]𓍯 Boutique
𓍯 General Supply
𓍯 Cafe / Kafe
𓍯 Pastry
𓍯 3 mini-stalls
[font=Arial]
[img]https://imgur.com/6FYo0bT.png[/img]﻿
Along with the shops, I thought about adding NPCs because.. I mean.. why not? At this current version (1.0), there are about 10 new NPCs for you to meet and get to know. There'll be atleast 2 more in the next (?) updates. 

Some of the NPCs have their own heart events. I've had so much fun learning things about making NPCs so I've added a little bit to the mix. I've not put so much focus on creating events for each NPCs so you can coin as 'side stuffs'. Though, if you'd like, I can try to add more of it.

Speaking of, here they are!
[spoiler]
[img]https://imgur.com/ZBiytMt.png[/img]﻿﻿
[/spoiler]

2 hearts: Boutique shop @whole day, Sunny weather
4 hearts: Sunnyfield Map @7PM - 12AM, any weather

If you'd like more stuffs included or added, you may do so at the comments/posts section.
